url.label: Address to check
url.description: An http or https address that answers with a small JSON document, or just answers. Enter demo to see every state without a network.

label.label: Name on the BUSY Bar
label.description: Up to 8 letters, shown beside the status: API, SHOP, BUILD.

field.label: JSON field with the status
field.description: A path into the answer, such as status.indicator or checks.0.state. Leave empty to only ask whether the address answers with success.

healthy.label: Values that mean healthy
healthy.description: Comma-separated, letter case ignored. Any other value of the field counts as down and is shown as the status word.
healthy.default: none, ok, up, passing, success, operational, green, true

interval.label: Seconds between checks
interval.description: The wheel changes it while the app runs; this is where it starts.

slow_ms.label: Slow above, milliseconds
slow_ms.description: A healthy answer that took longer than this turns the pulse amber and slow. 0 turns this off.

header.label: Request header
header.description: Optional, as Name: value, for an address that wants a token: Authorization: Bearer abc123.

sound.label: Sound when it goes down
sound.description: Plays a sound once when a healthy address stops being healthy.
